description: Seaports is a data set listed in Bahrain Open Data Portal (data.gov.bh), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Information & eGovernment Authority. Coverage: Bahrain. The portal files it under the publisher Information & eGovernment Authority. Its tags are GIS. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2023-06-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-gov-bh-portal.
